## Experiment

```{r}
translate_unique <- function(from = c("peacock", "dolphin", "dolphin", "bat", "bat", "dog"), 
                             lookup = data.frame(id1 = c("peacock", "dolphin", "bat"),
                                                 id_esp = c("pavo real", "delfín", "murciélago"),
                                                 id3 = c(   NA,    NA, "bunny"),
                                                 .to = c("blue", "turquoise", "black")), 
                             to_column = .to, 
                             missing_value = "grey" |> alpha(.5)){
  
  from_unique <- unique(from)
  
  lookup_long <- lookup |> 
    pivot_longer(cols = -{{to_column}})
  
  data.frame(value = from) |>
    left_join(lookup_long, by = "value") |> 
    pull({{to_column}}) |> 
    replace_na(missing_value)
  
}

translate_unique()


tribble(~animal,
        "dolphin",
        "peacock",
        "peacock",
        "bat",
        "dog",
        "dog") |> 
  ggplot() + 
  aes(x = animal,
      fill = animal |> translate_unique() |> I()) + 
  geom_bar()


us_map_ref <- usmapdata::us_map() |> rename(.to = geom)

head(us_map_ref)

to_state_geometry <- function(from = c("Texas"), lookup = us_map_ref, to_column = .to, missing_value = NA){
  
  translate_unique(from, lookup, {{to_column}}, missing_value)
  
}

to_state_geometry()

tribble(~state,
        "Texas",
        "Texas",
        "North Carolina",
        "Illinois",
        "California",
        "Argentina") |> 
  count(state) |>
  ggplot() + 
  aes(geometry = state |> to_state_geometry()) + # no I() required...
  geom_sf() + 
  aes(fill = n) 

```
